blocks.section: b. M527/E52545/M528/E52645 only: Do the following.
blocks.content: b. M527/E52545/M528/E52645 only: Do the following.
CAUTION: Never remove and then install a replacement DCC and formatter at the same time. Doing so will cause the printer to become unstable.
If a replacement DCC and formatter must be installed, first remove and install the formatter. Test operate the printer, and then if necessary install a replacement DCC.
